reuse.why: Replaces the per-action category queries with one new selection function that all month-wide actions use; copyPreviousMonth reuses it via an id set rather than its own hidden check.

duplication.why: Removes four copies of the category query and the copyPreviousMonth hidden check; the income/tracking gate is still repeated in every action, and getBudgetData still selects hidden flags nobody reads.

placement.why: The selection rule sits in budget/actions.ts next to the actions that use it.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions and focused tests; single-category actions untouched.

maintainability.why: One named, commented definition of which categories month-wide actions touch; the rule is expressed in SQL, so the income condition and template parsing stay outside it.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every month-wide action (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg) takes its category set from getMonthWideCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: None introduced; the remaining income gate per action predates the change.

one_place.where: getMonthWideCategories in budget/actions.ts decides hidden, hidden-group and templated exclusions for all month-wide actions.
